📡 How to Connect Your Android Phone:
1. Double-click Start_Bills_PC_Sync_Server.bat in your tcg-vault folder on this PC.
2. Open the Bill's PC Android App on your phone (connected to the same Wi-Fi) and go to the Sync tab.
3. Enter the Android Wi-Fi URL shown in the server window (e.g. http://192.168.1.X:8765).
